seoTitle: Add Appointment Scheduling to Squarespace with Acuity
metaDescription: Set up Squarespace's built-in Acuity scheduling or embed a third-party tool like Calendly so visitors can book appointments on your site.
intro: If you take bookings as a business owner or freelancer, adding a scheduling option to your Squarespace site makes it easy for visitors to reserve time with you. This guide covers the built-in Acuity Scheduling tool as well as embedding a third-party option like Calendly.

steps.heading: Log in and pick your site
steps.body: Sign in to Squarespace, using Continue with Google if linked, then choose the website you want to edit from your dashboard.

steps.heading: Set up Acuity Scheduling
steps.body: Go to Settings, then Scheduling, and link or create an Acuity account. Configure your availability, appointment types, and payment settings.

steps.heading: Create a dedicated scheduling page
steps.body: Go to Pages, click + Add Page, and choose Scheduling to create a standalone booking page, or add a Scheduling block to an existing page.

steps.heading: Or embed a third-party tool
steps.body: As an alternative, get an inline embed code from a service like Calendly and paste it into a code block on your page.

steps.heading: Preview and publish
steps.body: Preview your changes to confirm the scheduler displays and works correctly, then click Save to publish it live.

faq.question: What's the difference between Acuity and a third-party tool like Calendly?
faq.answer: Acuity is Squarespace's built-in, fully integrated scheduler, while third-party tools require embedding a code block and are generally considered more complicated to set up.

faq.question: Can I add a scheduling page to my site's menu?
faq.answer: Yes, once you create the scheduling page you can add its link to your site's navigation menu.

faq.question: Do I need a paid Acuity account?
faq.answer: You can start with a trial when linking your Acuity account, then configure billing and appointment types from there.

faq.question: Can I set my own rates and appointment lengths?
faq.answer: Yes, within Acuity you can create multiple appointment types and set custom rates and durations for each.
